clips.send: Tybee Island beach. Right on the ocean, so ships arrive easily — but it is open to storms and to Spanish warships, and fresh water is scarce on the sand.
clips.text: Tybee Island beach. Right on the ocean, so ships arrive easily — but it is open to storms and to Spanish warships, and fresh water is scarce on the sand.

clips.send: Upriver at the Fall Line. High, healthy ground — but more than 100 miles upriver. Big ships can’t get there, so every supply would take weeks.
clips.text: Upriver at the Fall Line. High, healthy ground — but more than 100 miles upriver. Big ships can’t get there, so every supply would take weeks.

clips.send: Yamacraw Bluff. A bluff about 40 ft high on the Savannah River, about 18 miles from the ocean: ships can sail up, the high ground is dry and easy to defend, and Tomochichi’s Yamacraw and Mary Musgrove’s trading post are next door.

clips.send: St. Marys River. Right on the edge of Spanish Florida — St. Augustine’s soldiers were only a few days away.
clips.text: St. Marys River. Right on the edge of Spanish Florida — St. Augustine’s soldiers were only a few days away.

clips.send: Mouth of the Altamaha River. A good river, but much closer to Spanish Florida and far from Carolina’s help — a dangerous place for a brand-new colony.
clips.text: Mouth of the Altamaha River. A good river, but much closer to Spanish Florida and far from Carolina’s help — a dangerous place for a brand-new colony.

clips.send: 泰碧岛海滩。就在海边，船很容易到——但风暴和西班牙战舰都能直扑过来，沙地上淡水也很少。

clips.send: 圣玛丽斯河。紧挨着西属佛罗里达——圣奥古斯丁的西班牙士兵几天就能赶到。
clips.text: 圣玛丽斯河. 紧挨着西属佛罗里达——圣奥古斯丁的西班牙士兵几天就能赶到。

clips.send: 阿尔塔马霍河口。河流不错，但离西属佛罗里达近得多，离卡罗来纳的援助又远——对刚起步的殖民地太危险了。

clips.send: 亚马克劳崖。萨凡纳河畔约 40 英尺高的崖地，距大海约 18 英里：船能开上来，高地干燥、易守难攻，托莫奇奇的亚马克劳人和玛丽·马斯格罗夫的贸易站就在旁边。

clips.send: 上游的瀑布线。地势高而健康——但在上游 100 多英里处。大船到不了，每次补给都要好几个星期。
